pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with sharp edge angularity and high pixel contrast against the background corridors. Patches on the mid-flank show larger spatial areas, while posterior and lower flank patches are smaller and more fragmented with increased edge complexity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph with numerous tri-radial junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows and becomes pixel-blurred where it meets the dorsal lesion boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Extremely irregular, high-amplitude silhouette characterized by coarse, jagged protrusions extending from the neck to the shoulder, caused by massive textural overgrowth rather than a standard mane structure.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive, dark, hyper-pigmented, and cauliflower-like textural overgrowth covering the entire visible dorsal ridge and upper neck, indicating severe dermal disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive hyper-keratotic lesions dominate the dorsal profile. Additionally, multiple small, dark, vertically-oriented avian silhouettes are present on the mid-flank and neck regions, causing localized pixel occlusion.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme spatial extent and thickness of the dorsal crusty lesions, which completely obscure the underlying pelage and mane geometry along the upper midline.
